name: atscale
description: Query governed business metrics, definitions and context from Cursor via AtScale MCP.

ATSCALE_MCP_URL.title: AtScale MCP Server URL
ATSCALE_MCP_URL.description: URL of the AtScale MCP server (e.g., `https://<your-atscale-domain>/mcp`).

ATSCALE_MCP_CLIENT_SECRET.title: AtScale MCP Client Secret
ATSCALE_MCP_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret for the AtScale MCP server. See your AtScale instance's Keycloak page > Clients > `atscale-mcp` > Credentials.
